method.beginnerReferenceReadyMeaning: Both bounded executable reference probes pass deterministically; this is not production readiness.

seed.name: One accessible page
seed.goal: Render one useful content page with semantic landmarks.

stretch.name: Small responsive publication
stretch.goal: Render a three-page navigation model with responsive and accessible structure.

frontierObservation.helpful: The profile made content navigation, responsiveness, and accessibility first-class instead of visual afterthoughts.
frontierObservation.needsTuning: It still needs a concrete browser/render adapter and content-quality checks before it can judge a real site.

seed.name: Validated counter form
seed.goal: Accept a valid event, reject invalid input, and update UI state.

stretch.name: Offline task route
stretch.goal: Model routes, an authentication boundary, and an offline action queue.

frontierObservation.helpful: The state, route, validation, authentication, and offline prompts prevented a frontier model from treating the web app as only screens.
frontierObservation.needsTuning: Framework-specific lifecycle, browser storage, and threat-model adapters remain external.

seed.name: Lifecycle-safe tap counter
seed.goal: Preserve simple state across a pause/resume cycle and process touch input.

stretch.name: Offline field capture
stretch.goal: Gate device permission, bound background work, and queue offline records for sync.

frontierObservation.helpful: Lifecycle, permission, offline, and background limits immediately changed the build plan from desktop-like assumptions.
frontierObservation.needsTuning: Real Android/iOS lifecycle and device APIs require platform adapters and representative device testing.

seed.name: Local note document
seed.goal: Handle a window event and produce a safe local-save intent.

stretch.name: Migrating cancellable editor
stretch.goal: Migrate local state, cancel a long task, and describe an update flow.

frontierObservation.helpful: The direction prompts exposed file boundaries, migration, cancellation, and install/update concerns that UI-first generation often misses.
frontierObservation.needsTuning: Native packaging, signing, filesystem permissions, and OS integration need platform-specific evidence.

seed.name: One-room movement loop
seed.goal: Advance a frame and move a player from mapped input under a simple rule.

stretch.name: Replayable score challenge
stretch.goal: Run a deterministic rules sequence and restore a versioned save.

frontierObservation.helpful: Frame loop, input, world ownership, rules, saves, and replay gave the model a much better game skeleton than a generic app prompt.
frontierObservation.needsTuning: Asset production, rendering, feel, performance profiling, and engine-specific lifecycle are still outside the profile.

seed.name: Deterministic population step
seed.goal: Advance explicit time and emit one measurement.

stretch.name: Reproducible scenario replay
stretch.goal: Repeat a seeded scenario, snapshot state, and bind replay provenance.

frontierObservation.helpful: The distinction between model state, explicit time, measurement, seed, and provenance kept the model from confusing animation with simulation truth.
frontierObservation.needsTuning: Domain equations, calibration data, uncertainty, and numerical validation need a subject-specific adapter.

seed.name: Tracked spatial target
seed.goal: Transform one tracked pose into a declared coordinate space and map an action.

stretch.name: Capability-aware comfort scene
stretch.goal: Negotiate a missing device feature, enforce a modeled frame budget, and hold unsafe motion.

frontierObservation.helpful: Coordinate ownership, device negotiation, latency, and comfort boundaries made the spatial assumptions explicit.
frontierObservation.needsTuning: The reference probe cannot replace headset observation, motion comfort studies, or hardware-in-loop evidence.

seed.name: Undoable layer edit
seed.goal: Apply a non-destructive layer operation and undo it exactly.

stretch.name: Bounded layered export
stretch.goal: Process a larger layer graph in chunks and preserve import/export provenance.

frontierObservation.helpful: The profile pushed edits toward reversible operations with explicit history, layer topology, streaming, and provenance.
frontierObservation.needsTuning: Real codec behavior, color/audio correctness, GPU limits, and third-party plugin isolation require adapters.

seed.name: Validated greeting endpoint
seed.goal: Honor a tiny request/response contract and reject malformed input.

stretch.name: Idempotent bounded job API
stretch.goal: Persist one job, serialize a repeated request at the boundary, enforce timeout, and emit bounded diagnostics.

frontierObservation.helpful: Contract, validation, errors, persistence, retries, observability, and timeout prompts prevented a happy-path-only endpoint.
frontierObservation.needsTuning: A framework, database, auth scheme, load target, and deployment environment still need explicit binding.

seed.name: Two-node partial failure
seed.goal: Contain one failed node and avoid duplicating a retried operation.

stretch.name: Rolling replicated service
stretch.goal: Model consistency, scaling, observability, and a rolling version change.

frontierObservation.helpful: Partial failure, idempotency, consistency, scaling, and rolling-change questions gave the frontier model the right failure vocabulary early.
frontierObservation.needsTuning: Real scheduler, network partitions, cloud costs, service discovery, and load evidence are not supplied by the profile.

seed.name: Consent-gated jitter buffer
seed.goal: Require capture consent and order a few delayed media packets.

stretch.name: Adaptive synchronized call
stretch.goal: Adapt quality to bandwidth, bound modeled clock skew, and fall back for a missing device feature.

frontierObservation.helpful: The profile made consent, jitter, synchronization, adaptation, and device negotiation part of the initial design.
frontierObservation.needsTuning: Codec, browser/media stack, real latency, packet loss, and load measurements need live adapters.

seed.name: Two-user shared counter
seed.goal: Merge ordered operations under one explicit authority rule.

stretch.name: Reconnectable shared session
stretch.goal: Resolve a concurrent edit, resynchronize a disconnected client, and reject abusive input.

frontierObservation.helpful: Authority, ordering, conflict, reconnect, prediction, and abuse boundaries stopped the model from assuming shared state is trivial.
frontierObservation.needsTuning: Transport choice, scale, anti-cheat/moderation policy, and real latency budgets still need context.

seed.name: Role-gated approval
seed.goal: Advance one approval state only for the allowed role.

stretch.name: Versioned order workflow
stretch.goal: Audit a rule-versioned transaction and preserve an in-flight workflow boundary.

frontierObservation.helpful: Roles, long-lived state, audit, rule versions, transactions, and compatibility made consequential business behavior visible.
frontierObservation.needsTuning: Actual regulation, accounting semantics, organizational policy, and external integrations require human/domain authority.

seed.name: Indexed record lookup
seed.goal: Validate a tiny schema and retrieve a record by an explicit query.

stretch.name: Transactional migration and restore
stretch.goal: Use an index, roll back a failed transaction, migrate, and restore a backup.

frontierObservation.helpful: Schema, query, index, transaction, migration, durability, and recovery prompts produced a more complete storage plan.
frontierObservation.needsTuning: Engine-specific isolation, realistic data volume, disk failure, and performance plans require real infrastructure.

seed.name: Validated row transform
seed.goal: Apply one reproducible transform and quarantine a malformed record.

stretch.name: Restartable partition pipeline
stretch.goal: Partition work, resume from checkpoint, repeat safely, and retain full lineage.

frontierObservation.helpful: Lineage, drift, checkpoints, idempotency, partitioning, quarantine, and reproducibility gave the model strong pipeline guardrails.
frontierObservation.needsTuning: Dataset contracts, privacy rules, scheduler behavior, and realistic throughput still need binding.

seed.name: Event-time window sum
seed.goal: Aggregate events by declared event time and preserve ordering information.

stretch.name: Late-event restartable stream
stretch.goal: Apply a late-event policy, backpressure, and checkpoint recovery.

frontierObservation.helpful: Event time, windows, ordering, delivery, backpressure, checkpoints, and late events exposed semantics that generic streaming prompts omit.
frontierObservation.needsTuning: Broker/runtime semantics, watermark strategy, scale, and operational recovery require an engine adapter.

seed.name: Filtered revenue measure
seed.goal: Compute one measure under an explicit filter context.

stretch.name: Traceable refreshed dashboard model
stretch.goal: Drill into a measure, bind data provenance and refresh version, and show uncertainty.

frontierObservation.helpful: Measure semantics, filter context, provenance, refresh, drilldown, and uncertainty prevented attractive-but-ambiguous dashboard logic.
frontierObservation.needsTuning: Business meaning, source reliability, privacy, and visualization usability still need human and data-owner review.

seed.name: Shape-checked threshold model
seed.goal: Separate a tiny training input from inference and run an evaluation harness.

stretch.name: Versioned fallback model
stretch.goal: Bind dataset/model versions, use a fallback path, observe drift, and retain uncertainty.

frontierObservation.helpful: Dataset provenance, shape, train/inference separation, evaluation, versions, fallback, uncertainty, and drift created a disciplined model boundary.
frontierObservation.needsTuning: The profile does not provide real datasets, model weights, safety evaluation, accelerator evidence, or deployment monitoring.

seed.name: Parallel vector reduction
seed.goal: Compare a decomposed numerical reduction with a reference under explicit tolerance.

stretch.name: Checkpointed reproducible sweep
stretch.goal: Resume a seeded parameter sweep and preserve result provenance.

frontierObservation.helpful: Precision, decomposition, layout, seeds, checkpoints, provenance, and reference data gave the model scientific rather than merely fast-compute priorities.
frontierObservation.needsTuning: Actual numerical methods, hardware topology, memory pressure, domain validation, and large-scale performance remain untested.

seed.name: Bounded privileged request
seed.goal: Reject an unprivileged request and model exclusive buffer ownership.

stretch.name: Interrupt-safe ABI model
stretch.goal: Bound interrupt work, preserve an ABI contract, and contain a simulated device fault.

frontierObservation.helpful: Privilege, ownership, locking, interrupt, ABI, lifecycle, and containment prompts strongly corrected ordinary application assumptions.
frontierObservation.needsTuning: This is only a userspace model; compiler, kernel, race, device, fuzz, and hardware evidence remain mandatory.

seed.name: Bounded sensor threshold
seed.goal: Read a modeled sensor within a fixed memory and step budget.

stretch.name: Power-aware rollback controller
stretch.goal: Model a power budget, isolate register access, and roll back a failed update.

frontierObservation.helpful: Memory, power, interrupts, registers, deadlines, communication, and rollback shifted the model toward bounded-device thinking.
frontierObservation.needsTuning: Board definitions, electrical behavior, toolchain, timing analysis, radio, and hardware-in-loop are still absent.

seed.name: Fail-safe bounded actuator
seed.goal: Keep a modeled actuator inside a safety envelope and enter fail-safe on bad input.

stretch.name: Synchronized fused control trace
stretch.goal: Fuse two sensors, synchronize messages, and preserve a simulation-to-hardware trace boundary.

frontierObservation.helpful: Control, fusion, safety envelope, messages, time, fail-safe, and traceability made physical consequences impossible to ignore.
frontierObservation.needsTuning: Plant dynamics, safety certification, sensor faults, real-time OS, and hardware-in-loop require experts and physical evidence.

seed.name: Bounded packet parser
seed.goal: Parse one valid packet and contain malformed lengths.

stretch.name: Congestion-aware retry route
stretch.goal: Apply timeout/retry, congestion backpressure, routing, and wire-version rules.

frontierObservation.helpful: Protocol state, packet boundaries, retries, congestion, routing, wire compatibility, and malformed input gave the model precise network seams.
frontierObservation.needsTuning: Real sockets, kernel queues, packet captures, interoperability, load, and latency need external adapters.

seed.name: Least-privilege session
seed.goal: Deny an unauthorized action and prevent secret disclosure in diagnostics.

stretch.name: Rotating audited identity
stretch.goal: Rotate an identity, record an audit event, and delegate cryptographic primitives to a named boundary.

frontierObservation.helpful: Trust, identity lifecycle, authorization, secrets, primitive boundaries, audit, and attacks kept the model from inventing casual security.
frontierObservation.needsTuning: No reference probe can certify security; approved primitives, threat review, fuzzing depth, operations, and independent audit remain required.

seed.name: Invariant-preserving transfer
seed.goal: Move a modeled balance deterministically while rejecting replay.

stretch.name: Governed irreversible upgrade
stretch.goal: Hold reentrancy, bound execution cost, and require explicit upgrade governance.

frontierObservation.helpful: Determinism, invariants, cost, reentrancy, governance, events, and irreversible holds gave the model the right high-risk checklist.
frontierObservation.needsTuning: Chain semantics, compiler, formal verification, economic attacks, governance law, and independent security review are not supplied.

seed.name: Dry-run rename command
seed.goal: Parse explicit arguments and describe a filesystem change without applying it.

stretch.name: Portable idempotent batch command
stretch.goal: Normalize paths, repeat safely, and emit structured diagnostics.

frontierObservation.helpful: Arguments, filesystem/process boundaries, dry-run, diagnostics, path portability, and idempotency produced a safer automation design.
frontierObservation.needsTuning: Actual shell behavior, permissions, signals, platform differences, and destructive-operation policy need runtime evidence.

seed.name: Tiny expression parser
seed.goal: Tokenize and parse one expression and locate a syntax diagnostic.

stretch.name: Scoped transform pipeline
stretch.goal: Resolve scope, preserve a transformation invariant, and keep execution behind a boundary.

frontierObservation.helpful: Parse, scope, semantics, IR, invariants, execution boundary, and diagnostics gave the model a coherent language pipeline.
frontierObservation.needsTuning: Grammar coverage, type system, optimization proof, target ABI, fuzz corpus, and compatibility policy remain language-specific.

seed.name: Stable greeting library
seed.goal: Expose one public API and prove its reference example.

stretch.name: Versioned sandboxed extension
stretch.goal: Preserve consumer compatibility, isolate a plugin lifecycle, and provide migration guidance.

frontierObservation.helpful: API, versions, consumers, host lifecycle, sandbox, migration, and examples pushed the model toward maintainable reuse.
frontierObservation.needsTuning: Package ecosystem, binary/API compatibility, hostile plugins, release automation, and real consumer matrices need adapters.

seed.name: Reproducible two-step build
seed.goal: Order a dependency graph and reproduce the same artifact digest.

stretch.name: Idempotent reversible deployment
stretch.goal: Apply desired state twice, inject a secret only at runtime, and retain rollback.

frontierObservation.helpful: Graph, reproducibility, desired state, idempotency, environment, secrets, rollback, and provenance made deployment a designed system.
frontierObservation.needsTuning: Concrete CI, cloud/runtime, credentials, policy, supply-chain scanning, and rollback drills require external infrastructure.
